findings.finding: Adoption of this candidate is not a three-file edit: all three targets are FROZEN rev29 members, so the owner must bump FROZEN to rev30 and re-pin artifacts/formulation/evidence/variant_registry_check.json and artifacts/formulation/evidence/variant_delta_check.json, which the live checkers rewrite when run in-tree. Measured: none of those bytes moved during this verification.
findings.falsifier: an adoption that leaves FROZEN or either evidence pin at the rev29 values while the candidate bytes are live.

findings.finding: The live SET clause is a mention-match ('STRONGER' not in strength): independently reproduced as a false pass on the live level-mixed label and a fail once the bracket provenance note is stripped. The candidate clause is assertion-aware and additionally requires the class-level qualifier and the predicate-level weakening; this verification confirms it fails closed on all three assertion mutants tested.
findings.falsifier: a schema/label pair that satisfies the candidate clause while asserting the wrong class or predicate direction, or a de-qualified label that still passes it.

findings.finding: research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml:199 (class-level 'strictly stronger') remains the open position-A/B item (worker-094 predicate reading vs lead measurement_6 class reading). The candidate labels are correct under either reading, but a predicate-level clarification of F0:199 is a no-write artifact under G-F0 and cannot be made by a worker; if the gate owner adopts position A it must ride the same authorized revision.
findings.falsifier: an F0:199 write that voids G-F0 0abb9ed8a961, or an adoption that cites this review as adjudicating position A/B.

falsifier: Falsified if, at the pins recorded in report.json: any guard byte moves; a candidate differs from live outside its declared sites; repair.patch does not reproduce the candidates; the live label is level-qualified and anchor-consistent under the published predicate (or the candidate label is not); a declared mutation does not flip the expected checker exit; or a sibling checker regresses on the candidate tree. An adopted revision at a new hash voids these pins and requires a re-run.
